verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Mailchimp serves a live llms.txt file at mailchimp.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a 'Web Content Analysis' summary that an agent could consume, satisfying the core story. missing for 10: the content appears to be a generic auto-generated summary rather than a rich, curated agent-oriented documentation set, and there is no independent corroboration of agents actually using it or additional agent-specific docs (e.g., AGENTS.md, MCP docs) beyond standard API references.
